author: Davidgo5867

english.text: On the 7th of March of 2022, I left my Lulu Island house around 10:10 in the morning to walk to the pizzeria, where I ate two pizza slices and drank cold black diet cola. The big screen television was blank. The place was silent. The vendor was an East Indian from Mumbai, not the usual Rose the Filipina, as it was the case on Mondays and Saturdays. As I was homebound, a mesomorphic man in black outpaced me, as he mumbled a song, of which language I was not certain.

jyutping: hai2 2022 nin4 3 jyut6 7 hou6，ngo5 hai2 ziu1 zou2 10 dim2 10 fan1 zo2 jau2 lei4 hoi1 ngo5 ge3 lou6 lou6 dou2 uk1 kei2，haang4 heoi3 bok6 beng2 dim3，hai2 go2 dou6 ngo5 sik6 zo2 loeng5 pin3 bok6 beng2，jam2 zo2 dung3 hak1 sik1 ge3 gaam2 fei4 ho2 lok6。go3 dei6 fong1 hou2 zing6。dong1 ngo5 hai2 uk1 kei2 ge3 si4 hau6，jat1 go3 zoek3 zyu6 hak1 sik1 ge3 zung1 jing4 naam4 jan2 ciu1 jyut6 zo2 ngo5，keoi5 gu4 lu4 gu4 lu4 gam2 coeng3 jat1 sau2 go1，ngo5 m4 hang2 ding6 hai6 bin1 zung2 jyu5 jin4。
text: 喺2022年3月7號，我喺朝早10點10分左右離開我嘅露露島屋企，行去薄餅店，喺嗰度我食咗兩片薄餅，飲咗凍黑色嘅減肥可樂。個地方好靜。當我喺屋企嘅時候，一個着住黑色嘅中型男人超越咗我，佢咕嚕咕嚕噉唱一首歌，我唔肯定係邊種語言。

author: Davidgo5867

english.text: Naomi said, "Go back, my daughters. Why do you want to go with me? Do I still have sons in my womb, that they may be your husbands? Go back, my daughters, go your way; for I am too old to have a husband. If I should say, 'I have hope,' if I should even have a husband tonight, and should also bear sons, would you then wait until they were grown? Would you then refrain from having husbands? No, my daughters, for it grieves me seriously for your sakes, for the Lord's hand has gone out against me."

text: 娜奧米話：「返去啦，我啲囡囡。你哋點解要同我一齊去？我仲有冇仔喺我個胎度，等佢哋可以做你哋嘅老公？返去啦，我啲囡囡，走你哋嘅路啦；因為我太老喇，冇老公。如果我話：『我有希望』，如果我今晚甚至應該有個老公，同埋應該生個仔，噉你會唔會等到佢哋大個咗先至有老公？ 我為你而認真悲傷，因為主嘅手已經伸出嚟攻擊我。」

author: Davidgo5867

english.text: Such close had Priam's fortunes; so his days / were finished, such the bitter end he found, / now doomed by Fate with dying eyes to gaze / on Troy in flames and ruin all around, / and Pergamus laid level with the ground. / Lo, he to whom once Asia bowed the knee, / proud lord of many peoples, far-renowned, / now left to welter by the rolling sea, / a huge and headless trunk, a nameless corpse is he.

text: 普里亞姆嘅運氣好近；所以佢嘅日子 / 已經過咗，就係佢搵到嘅苦澀結局， / 而家命運注定要用死眼凝視 / 四周都係火焰同廢墟嘅特洛伊， / 而佩加姆斯就同地面一樣咁平躺 / 洛，曾經亞洲向佢跪低咗嘅佢， / 許多民族嘅驕傲之主，遠遠出名， / 而家留低喺滾滾嘅海面， / 佢係一個巨大而冇頭嘅屍體。

author: Davidgo5867

english.text: Today is the 9th of July of 2025, a bit of a wet day for summer. At Tim Hortons café, I partied by myself by eating two Supreme Stack sandwiches at different times, an extravagant expense for me. I drank two Iced Coffees with oat milk and an Iced Classic Lemonade. I didn't have a Fruit Explosion Muffin. I saw Lyle the white man sitting at a different corner. On the 7th, I went to the "Clam Temple," the Roman Catholic church on St. Albans Road, for the 66th time this year. On the 6th, I met Timur the Kazakh, waiting for his "fiery Persian" girlfriend at Tim Hortons café. The first time that I saw him, I enquired: "Are you Japanese? Filipino? Chinese? Korean? I couldn't guess..." as he denied the sequence of guesses. He was "Kazakh," like my pizza delivery man friend Adil from years ago at Pizza Hut. Timur is a handsome man, part-Russian and speaks Russian, Kazakh, and heavily accented English. He was wearing green camouflage army shorts. We talked about a lot of things, including his interest in video games and the auxlang Interslavic.

jyutping: gam1 jat6 hai6 2025 nin4 7 jyut6 9 hou6，deoi3 haa6 tin1 lai4 gong2 jau5 di1 sap1。hai2 Tim Hortons gaa3 fe1 gun2，ngo5 jat1 go3 jan4 hoi1 paai3 deoi3，hai2 m4 tung4 si4 gaan3 sik6 zo2 loeng5 go3 Supreme Stack saam1 man4 zi6，deoi3 ngo5 lai4 gong2 hai6 jat1 go3 ce1 ci2 ge3 hoi1 zi1。ngo5 jam2 zo2 loeng5 bui1 jin3 mak6 naai5 ge3 bing1 gaa3 fe1 tung4 jat1 bui1 bing1 ging1 din2 ning4 mung1 seoi2。ngo5 mou5 sik6 gwo3 seoi2 gwo2 baau3 zaa3 cung4 lou6。ngo5 gin3 dou2 go3 baak6 jan4 Lyle zo6 hai2 ling6 jat1 go3 gok3 lok6。hai2 7 hou6，ngo5 heoi3 zo2 sing3 aa3 ji5 bun2 si1 dou6 ge3 lo4 maa5 tin1 zyu2 gaau3 gaau3 tong2「gap3 lei4 miu2」，gam1 nin4 dai6 66 ci3。hou6，ngo5 gin3 dou2 haa1 saat3 hak1 jan4 Timur ，keoi5 hai2 Tim Hortons gaa3 fe1 gun2 dang2 gan2 keoi5 go3「fo2 jit6 ge3 bo1 si1 jan4」neoi5 pang4 jau5。dai6 jat1 ci3 gin3 dou2 keoi5，ngo5 man6：「nei5 hai6 jat6 bun2 jan4？fei1 leot6 ban1 jan4？zung1 gwok3 jan4？hon4 gwok3 jan4？ngo5 gu2 m4 dou2 … … 」，jan1 wai6 keoi5 fau2 jing6 zo2 ni1 go3 caai1 caak1 ge3 seon6 zeoi6，zau6 hou2 ci5 ngo5 gei2 nin4 cin4 hai2 Pizza Hut ge3 bok6 beng2 caan1 jyun4 pang4 jau5 Adil gam2 tung4 maai4 sik1 gong2 ngo4 man2、haa1 saat3 hak1 man4 tung4 maai4 cung5 hau2 jam1 ge3 jing1 man2。keoi5 zoek3 zyu6 gin6 luk6 sik1 mai4 coi2 gwan1 zong1 dyun2 fu3。 ngo5 dei6 king1 zo2 hou2 do1 je5，baau1 kut3 keoi5 deoi3 din6 zi2 jau4 hei3 ge3 hing3 ceoi3 tung4 maai4 fu6 si6 gaan1 si1 laai1 fu1。
text: 今日係2025年7月9號，對夏天嚟講有啲濕。喺 Tim Hortons 咖啡館，我一個人開派對，喺唔同時間食咗兩個 Supreme Stack 三文治，對我嚟講係一個奢侈嘅開支。我飲咗兩杯燕麥奶嘅冰咖啡同一杯冰經典檸檬水。我冇食過水果爆炸松露。我見到個白人 Lyle 坐喺另一個角落。喺7號，我去咗聖阿爾本斯道嘅羅馬天主教教堂「蛤蜊廟」，今年第66次。號，我見到哈薩克人 Timur ，佢喺 Tim Hortons 咖啡館等緊佢個「火熱嘅波斯人」女朋友。第一次見到佢，我問：「你係日本人？菲律賓人？中國人？韓國人？我估唔到 … … 」，因為佢否認咗呢個猜測嘅順序，就好似我幾年前喺 Pizza Hut 嘅薄餅餐員朋友 Adil 噉同埋識講俄文、哈薩克文同埋重口音嘅英文。佢着住件綠色迷彩軍裝短褲。 我哋傾咗好多嘢，包括佢對電子遊戲嘅興趣同埋輔士間斯拉夫。

author: Davidgo5867

english.text: As for my own part, I past through all these nations as you perhaps may have done through a croud at a shew-jostling to get by them, holding my nose with one hand, and defending my pockets with the other, without speaking a word to any of them, while I was pressing on to see what I wanted to see.

jyutping: zi3 jyu1 ngo5 zi6 gei2 ge3 bou6 fan6，ngo5 ging1 gwo3 zo2 so2 jau5 ni1 di1 gwok3 gaa1，zau6 hou2 ci5 nei5 ho2 nang4 wui5 hai2 jat1 go3 biu2 jin2 zung1 cyun1 gwo3 keoi5 dei6 ge3 jan4 kwan4 gam2，jung6 jat1 zek3 sau2 pou5 zyu6 ngo5 go3 bei6，jung6 ling6 jat1 zek3 sau2 heoi3 hon5 wai6 ngo5 ge3 hau2 doi6，ji4 ngo5 mou5 tung4 keoi5 dei6 jam6 ho4 jat1 go3 gong2 jat1 geoi3 syut3 waa6，ji4 ngo5 zau6 gai3 zuk6 tai2 gan2 ngo5 soeng2 tai2 di1 me1。
text: 至於我自己嘅部分，我經過咗所有呢啲國家，就好似你可能會喺一個表演中穿過佢哋嘅人群噉，用一隻手抱住我個鼻，用另一隻手去捍衛我嘅口袋，而我冇同佢哋任何一個講一句說話，而我就繼續睇緊我想睇啲咩。

author: Davidgo5867

english.text: "But who are ye, pray answer? on what quest / come ye? and whence and whither are ye bound?" / Her then AEneas, from his inmost breast / heaving a deep-drawn sigh, with labouring speech addressed: / "O Goddess, should I from the first unfold, / or could'st thou hear, the annals of our woe, / eve's star were shining, ere the tale were told."

jyutping: 「daan6 hai6 nei5 dei6 hai6 bin1 go3，kau4 nei5 daap3？nei5 dei6 lei4 gan2 zou6 mat1 je5？nei5 dei6 jiu3 hai2 bin1 dou6 tung4 bin1 dou6 sau6 cuk1 bok3？」 / keoi5 dong1 si4 ge3 oi1 nei4 aa3 si1，cung4 keoi5 ge3 zeoi3 sam1 cyu3 / sam1 sam1 ge3 taan3 sik1，jung6 lou4 leoi6 ge3 syut3 waa6 gong2 : / 「neoi5 san4 aa1，ngo5 jing1 goi1 jau4 dai6 jat1 ci3 zin2 hoi1， / waak6 ze2 nei5 ting1 m4 ting1 dou3，ngo5 dei6 ge3 zoi1 naan6 nin4 gaam3， / cin4 zik6 ge3 sing1 sing1 hai6 sim2 sim2 faat3 gwong1，hai2 gu3 si6 bei6 gong2 ceot1 lai4 zi1 cin4。」
text: 「但係你哋係邊個，求你答？你哋嚟緊做乜嘢？你哋要喺邊度同邊度受束縛？」 / 佢當時嘅埃尼亞斯，從佢嘅最深處 / 深深嘅嘆息，用勞累嘅說話講 : / 「女神啊，我應該由第一次展開， / 或者你聽唔聽到，我哋嘅災難年鑑， / 前夕嘅星星係閃閃發光，喺故事被講出嚟之前。」
